statistic: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of target MCC across the three tier-panel oracles

gate.statistic: maximum target MCC across the three tier-panel oracles
gate.purpose: designs that fail on every oracle are shared failures; they receive no tier

cuts.rule: High if D < 0.05; Moderate if 0.05 <= D <= 0.15; Low if D > 0.15

calibration.cohort: Ribonanza GPN15k sub-library, 2A3 SHAPE, 14,271 sequences in 99 construct clusters
calibration.statistic: mean per-position standard deviation (ddof=0) of paired/unpaired calls across the three oracles; the cohort has no design target, so target MCC is undefined there
calibration.transfer: OpenKnotAIDesignData (25,930 designs, 13 entries): with the gate applied, the target-MCC statistic above keeps the monotone High > Moderate > Low ordering of mean SHAPE AUC under the same cut-offs

scope: Tiers apply only to the three-oracle panel above. A different panel, the family-balanced statistic, or another oracle configuration inherits no cut-offs without recalibration.
Tiers describe structural risk calibrated retrospectively against SHAPE-derived pairing accuracy. They do not predict biological function and are not calibrated for 3D structure.
Rank candidates by Q_mean or Q_worst; use the tier as a robustness flag, not as a quality ranking.
